title: Will James Talarico be the top ActBlue fundraiser on Oct 16 at 10:00 AM ET?
rules: If James Talarico is the top ActBlue fundraiser on Oct 16 at 10:00 AM ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
Fundraiser rankings are determined by the “Top fundraisers from this week” list displayed on ActBlue’s official directory page. The leftmost candidate is considered the top fundraiser.

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with ActBlue. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

blind.reasoning: Talarico has been the biggest Democratic small-dollar fundraiser of the 2026 cycle, with record quarters ($27M in Q1, about $30M from roughly 780,000 donors in Q2). He's in the costliest, toss-up Senate race, and the flu and debate fight this week could drive donations. Kalshi running a separate question on whether he'd top the list suggests he's often a leading contender. Still, the result depends on a single weekly snapshot just before the midterms, so a surge for a rival like Ossoff, Platner or Brown could beat him.
blind.falsifier: Another candidate (e.g., Ossoff, Platner, Sherrod Brown, or someone whose fundraising goes viral) is the leftmost name on ActBlue's 'Top fundraisers from this week' list at 10:00 AM ET on Oct 16, 2026.

final.reasoning: The 0.85 midpoint likely reflects traders watching ActBlue's live weekly list, which I couldn't see, so I've moved most of the way toward it. I have no concrete evidence that someone else will be on top Oct 16, so I'm not betting either way.
